# Session HUD
A desktop floating HUD for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

When you minimize DSH, a small glass window stays on top of your desktop and shows the
live status o

f your sessions — which one is running, which one is waiting for your
approval, which one just finis

hed. Click a row and DSH comes back to that exact
session. Move the window to a screen edge and it c

ollapses into a slim marker that
expands on hover, so it never gets in your way.
> Windows 10/11 · DSH desktop 0.2.x · first use downloads the Electron runtime once (~110 MB).
## Features

- **Follows the DSH window**: hidden while DSH is on screen, appears when DSH is
minimized or hidden

, hides again when DSH comes back.
- **Live session status**: running / waiting for approval / just

finished / error,
with tool name, turn/step and elapsed time.
- **One click back to the session**: o

pens DSH (restoring it if minimized) and
navigates to the selected session.
- **Edge dock**: drag th

e HUD to the left, right or top edge and it collapses into a
slim status marker (colored beacon + ru

nning-session count). Hover to expand,
drag the title bar back in to restore the normal floating win

dow.
- **Inline approvals**: pending approval cards can be allowed/denied directly from
the HUD.
- *

*Opacity, always-on-top and follow-mode** controls in the footer; settings and
position persist betw

een restarts.
- **Content-free logging**: diagnostics never record session titles, identifiers or
ab

- **Content-free logging**: diagnostics never record session titles, identifiers or
absolute paths.
## Requirements

- **Windows 10/11** (x64). macOS/Linux are not supported yet.
- **DeepSeek Harness desktop app 0.2.x

** (the plugin uses the desktop host's
window-state reporting; the browser-hosted `dsh web` build ha

s no desktop window
to follow).
- ~110 MB of free disk space for the Electron runtime (downloaded on

ce, shared by
all versions of this plugin).

## Usage
| Action | How |

| Show / hide | Sidebar footer button, or let it follow the DSH window |
| Open a session | Click a

row in the HUD |
| Answer an approval | Click 允许 / 拒绝 on the approval card |
| Edge dock | Drag the

window within 24 px of the left/right/top edge |
| Expand docked HUD | Hover the edge marker (or cli

ck it) |
| Undock | Drag the expanded panel's title bar back into the screen |
| Follow mode | Foote

r 「跟随」 chip (on = follow the DSH window) |
| Opacity / always-on-top | Footer controls |
## Data and privacy

- The HUD reads **session metadata only** (title, status, recent tool name, timing)
from the running

DSH host. It never reads message bodies and never writes them.
- All communication is a local HTTP

bridge on `127.0.0.1:41333–41342`. Nothing is
sent to the network; there is no telemetry. The only n

etwork request is the
one-time Electron runtime download.
- Diagnostics are opt-in (`HUD_DEBUG=1`) a

nd are content-free by design: session
identifiers and absolute paths are redacted before anything i

s written.
- Runtime state (window position, dock edge, opacity, logs) lives in
`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\
session-hud\`. Delete that folder to reset everything.
## Uninstall
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The runtime cache and settings in `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\session-hud\` are kept so that
re-installing d

oes not download the runtime again. Remove that folder manually if you
want to reclaim the space and

d the runtime again. Remove that folder manually if you
want to reclaim the space and reset the HUD.
## Troubleshooting

- **HUD does not appear**: check that the plugin is enabled for the `desktop` profile,
then restart

DSH. While DSH is visible the HUD stays hidden by design — minimize DSH
or click the sidebar button.

- **"runtime download failed"**: check the log under
`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\session-hud\logs\hud-host.

log`, then either retry
(`/hud/restart` from the client, or restart DSH) or set `HUD_ELECTRON_PATH`.

- **Port already in use**: the bridge scans 41333–41342; if all ports are busy the
plugin logs an e

rror and the HUD button shows "未连接".
- **Docked window looks odd after an upgrade**: delete
`%USERPR
OFILE%\.dsh\session-hud\userdata\overlay-state.json` to reset the geometry.
